commit_scope: The r1 review blocker fix, new CPU regressions and revised launch runbook are committed in dad4d394. This regenerated readiness record is committed separately.

blockers_addressed.summary: An outer rsync owner timeout/death left its rsh wrapper and SSH session alive, retaining shared admission indefinitely
blockers_addressed.fix: The rsh CLI binds Transport to an identity-stable Windows parent handle or POSIX direct-parent reparenting watch. Transport polls the actual rsync owner while waiting on its supervisor, requests cancellation, waits for session reaping, and exits. Gate lock/reservation/rate waits also check owner lifetime. The supervisor alone clears active.json after reaping, preserving exclusion even when rsync or the wrapper is killed.
blockers_addressed.deadline_fix: Both cpus_checking rsync integrations pass their existing 1800/600-second budgets into rsync_shell, which creates an absolute monotonic deadline before rsync startup. Their outer subprocess.run timeouts remain. Owner death and the inner deadline independently trigger supervised cleanup, without replaying the operation or closing the separate persistent master.
regressions: test_real_rsync_owner_hop_cancels_wrapper_and_session: real extra owner -> rsh wrapper -> supervisor -> local session process chain; terminate, kill, actual subprocess.run outer timeout, and absolute inner deadline
Each owner-hop case asserts bounded session cleanup, exclusion throughout session lifetime, wrapper exit, eventual gate reuse, reservation removal, and exactly one dispatch
test_rsync_owner_checked_during_admission: owner death during lock, active reservation and rate waits
test_rpc_and_rsync_are_routed_only_for_cpuv: finite absolute deadlines for both transfer budgets and unchanged legacy-host routing
test_streaming_and_rsync_preserve_external_lifetime: CLI binds and closes the actual owner watch even without a duration limit
test_expired_wrapper_startup_deadline_never_constructs_transport: run and rsh refuse expired startup budgets
blockers_addressed.runbook: CLEAN1_LAUNCH.md documents the extra owner hop, deadline propagation, cleanup after outer caller return, durable gate exclusion, and updated CPU qualification scope

implementation.control_master: yes for the persistent master, no for sessions
implementation.shared_pool_scope: All agents/worktrees on the same Linux/WSL client and OS user; independent of arm/run/PID
implementation.session_cleanup: Independent supervisor terminates/reaps the owned session/group before clearing its durable reservation; rsh wrappers additionally poll rsync parent lifetime every 50 ms during admission and supervisor waits
implementation.external_owner_timeout: Outer caller return need not await cleanup. The surviving rsh wrapper requests cancellation and waits for supervisor/session reaping; active.json excludes other sessions throughout cleanup. The wrapper then exits. No operation replay.
implementation.abrupt_supervisor_or_launch_failure: Reservation remains fail-closed; documented operator recovery requires confirming all owned session processes have exited
implementation.platform: Linux/WSL OpenSSH. Windows tests use local Python children only; native Windows network use remains refused.

api.Transport: Transport(directory=None, owner_dead=None); optional internal owner-death callback used by rsh
api.command: command(host, remote_command, timeout=None, legacy=None) -> gated argv with absolute startup deadline for finite cpuV budgets; legacy argv for other hosts
api.rsync_shell: rsync_shell(host, timeout=None) -> rsh command string; cpuV carries an optional absolute deadline and watches its actual rsync parent even when timeout=None
api.Gate: Gate(directory, check_owner=callback, clock=..., wall=..., sleep=...); claim(deadline=None) and admit(deadline=None) preserve durable exclusion and persisted rate spacing
api.cli: python -B -m tools.coopmwm.cpuv_ssh [--timeout SECONDS] run -- COMMAND | put LOCAL ABSOLUTE_REMOTE | get LOCAL ABSOLUTE_REMOTE | rsh cpuV COMMAND...
api.timeouts: Default CLI execution budget 180 seconds. Zero removes duration limit; rsh owner watch remains active. Cleanup may extend beyond execution deadline. cpuV RPC calls await inner cleanup; rsync retains both outer and inner budgets.
api.runbook: CLEAN1_LAUNCH.md, F6 cpuV SSH connection discipline

arm_invariants.B_R: Identical arm-independent transport, cancellation, admission and deadline rules
arm_invariants.other_hosts: Original argv and outer timeout behavior retained; cpuQ regressions pass
